text: Ignore — bookkeeping marker, not a finding.

Removed the pretooluse-hook advisory record and its two JSDoc mentions per plan step 1-2; renderLedgerReadme() already carries the tool-neutral 'must never be hand-edited / generated-by marker' statement unchanged, so no replacement advisory text was added (step 2 verification, no code change needed there).

Retitled the exact-set advisory test and removed 'pretooluse-hook' from the expected id array per plan step 3; kept the exact-set assertion shape so a future reintroduction fails loudly. Verified via targeted vitest run: 21/21 passing.

Documented the sensitive-output-path warning in three places per plan step 4: OutputConfigSchema JSDoc, a new constraints-storage.md subsection, and one sentence in README.md's ledger section. No schema refinement or runtime denylist added, per constraints-code-style.md. Confirmed api-surface.md has no OutputConfigSchema entry to update.

Added the leaf-symlink regression case per plan step 5, directly after the intermediate-directory symlink case, reusing the existing symlink import and temp-directory fixture. No platform guard added, matching the pre-existing unmitigated gap on the sibling test (per plan Constraints). Verified via targeted vitest run: 21/21 passing.

Added a Tool-Agnostic Policy section modeled on Cross-Platform Policy per step 6, plus a Root-Level/Cross-Project maintenance-table row (step 10b) and removed the PreToolUse hook-snippet mention from the ledger-project-core.js tooling row (step 10a). Caught and fixed a self-introduced AC-04 violation: the policy's rationale line initially named 'PreToolUse' directly, which would have failed the repository-wide grep criterion — reworded to 'harness-specific hook advisory' before finalizing.

Deleted the AGENTS.md->CLAUDE.md content-copy block from cmdCtxGenerate() (step 7a), replaced the workspace-root CLAUDE.md with the single-line @AGENTS.md import (step 7b), and added the missing mcp-server/CLAUDE.md companion (step 7c). Confirmed no existing test asserted the deleted sync behavior.

Added an instant-tier 'claude-md-companion' health check binding the two known AGENTS.md files to their CLAUDE.md companions, per step 8, hardcoding the path pairs (no directory scan) per the plan's stated rationale. Added dedicated pass/missing/empty/extra-content test cases by temporarily mutating mcp-server/CLAUDE.md and restoring it in afterEach; verified restoration byte-for-byte after the test run. Updated the exact-count and exact-id-set assertions in health-checks.test.js. All 20 tests pass.

Documented the companion contract per step 9: added a note in Generated Context Docs that CLAUDE.md is not generated, a Cross-System Dependencies row for the AGENTS.md<->CLAUDE.md pairing naming the health check as guard, and a maintenance-table row obliging a companion for any new AGENTS.md. Updated the scripts/lib/health-checks.js Root-Level Tooling row to mention the new check. Confirmed docs/references/menu-guide.md and scripts/cli.js's own tooling row never mentioned the old sync/hook, so no removal was needed there.

Ran node scripts/cli.js ctx-generate per step 11; ctx was available on PATH. Verified CLAUDE.md and mcp-server/CLAUDE.md byte-for-byte unchanged after the run (AC-14), and that .context/ no longer contains any PreToolUse reference. Repository-wide grep confirms the only remaining PreToolUse hits are under docs/agents/plans/ (immutable historical plan artefacts, including this plan's own plan.md/research-brief.md).

Root npm test flaked with four 5s test timeouts on a cold run because scripts/lib/ledger-bridge.js rebuilds mcp-server/dist on first use, and the build itself takes longer than vitest's default 5000ms per-test timeout. Rebuilding mcp-server/dist beforehand (npm run build) made all four pass cleanly on rerun. Consider either raising the timeout for the specific tests that trigger a first-use dist rebuild, or having the rebuild step run once in a global setup file, so a cold checkout doesn't intermittently fail npm test for a reason unrelated to the code under test.

Added a patch entry (v2.10.1) to mcp-server/changelog.md for the sensitive-path documentation and leaf-symlink test, and a minor entry (v2.13.0) to root changelog.md for the advisory removal, Tool-Agnostic Policy, and CLAUDE.md import switch (a minor bump since it changes build behavior and adds a durable workspace policy, not just documentation). personas/changelog.md untouched, matching the plan's explicit constraint. node scripts/cli.js check-versions passes.
